title: G2 fix round 2: packet truncation drops the discovery sections before the acceptance list; trim acceptance first and protect symbols and relevant_tests (review T-0289)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain e635445 "Fix packet relevant test selection" (T-0284) over acbec94 (T-0266) in git log; never drop them.
Review T-0289 on T-0284 (high): spawn.packet's cap trims sections in reverse order, so evidence, verify, decisions, gotchas, symbols, relevant_tests, read_scope, write_scope and base are emptied before the acceptance section is ever trimmed, although execute.md already renders {{acceptance}} verbatim. A task with about 100 acceptance items yields a packet with only objective and part of acceptance: the discovery data the packet exists for is gone.
Change spawn.packet truncation:
1. Trim order when over the cap (4,800 chars): first the acceptance section down to its first 5 bullets plus 'N more in the task', then evidence, then decisions, then gotchas, then read_scope; symbols and relevant_tests are trimmed last and only by dropping trailing entries (never emptied while any other trimmable section still has content); objective, base, write_scope and verify are never trimmed. The final line 'packet truncated: N chars dropped; bus_read(task_id) has the full task' stays.
2. Tests in tests/test_spawn.py: test_packet_trims_acceptance_before_discovery (100 acceptance items: symbols and relevant_tests keep entries, acceptance shows 5 plus the remainder note), test_packet_never_trims_base_or_verify; keep the seven earlier packet tests green.
3. Verify in the final message with T-0256's task json (packet under 4,800 chars, symbols and relevant_tests non-empty) and with a synthetic task carrying 100 acceptance bullets.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows e635445 and acbec94 below your commit
tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_trims_acceptance_before_discovery, ::test_packet_never_trims_base_or_verify pass and the seven earlier packet tests still pass
final message shows a 100-bullet synthetic task keeps symbols and relevant_tests in the packet
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
